policy: One combined TASM1/2 Red kit; Overclock, Dragnet and Vortex are its final added skills. The cape-free Across the Spider-Verse 2099 Black appearance is published; the Hunter combat design (revision 3, 2026-10-24) has 14 skills: the seven native Black rows plus seven Black rows on free saved bits 83..89, all unimplemented. Preserve native controls, ownership/dependencies, Both Suits traversal and rewards. Prices, third suit, save expansion and branches remain deferred.

combat_design.request: Make Black play and fight as close as possible to Miguel O'Hara in Across the Spider-Verse; make it fun. Revision 1 review: avoid one-trick pinning, answer bosses, add webbing and air combos, add rows as needed within the 2D mob/boss brawler. Revision 2 review: X for webs approved; remove Collar Toss and Lariat; add one skill that rewards a full combo meter like Red's Momentum/Overclock.
combat_design.supersedes: Hunter revision 2 (15 rows, 2026-10-23), revision 1 and the 2026-10-22 catch/carry/crash/chase proposal

suits.implementation_order: Appearance shipped (v0.30.2/v0.30.3). Combat awaits the player's go-ahead: clear the code-space, shop, input, Black-only animation and boss-adapter gates; then publish one slice at a time with a player verdict between: Web Yank pipeline proof, Sky slice, Boss slice, Ground slice, Apex Predator.
